header.title: Vacademy Assistant
header.description: The in-app AI assistant for your team. Control which capabilities it can use for everyone, and grant extra capabilities to specific roles below. Access is always limited to this institute.

capabilities.title: Capabilities for everyone
capabilities.description: Enabled for every non-learner role in your institute.

perRole.title: Per-role access (advanced)
perRole.description: Grant extra capabilities to specific roles, on top of the institute-wide set above. Leave a role uncustomized to use the institute-wide settings.

toasts.presetApplied: Preset applied — click Save settings to confirm.

search_help_knowledge.label: Help & how-to guidance
search_help_knowledge.description: Answers “how do I / where do I” questions about using the portal, with step-by-step instructions.

learner_data.label: Learner data lookup
learner_data.description: Find learners by name/email/phone and answer questions about their attendance, assessment scores, activity, course progress and login summary — and generate their full analysis report. On by default for Admins; grant to other roles below.

payments.label: Payments & fees
payments.description: Answer questions about a learner’s payment history, outstanding/overdue fees, and payment plans. On by default for Admins.

batch_data.label: Batch rosters
batch_data.description: List the learners in a batch and answer batch headcount questions. On by default for Admins.

schedule.label: Class schedule
schedule.description: Answer “what classes are live/upcoming” and “what do I have today” from the live-session schedule. On by default for Admins.

institute_overview.label: Institute overview
institute_overview.description: Institute-wide snapshots: total overdue fees, live classes right now, active learner counts. On by default for Admins.

learner_edits.label: Learner edits (actions)
learner_edits.description: Let the assistant PROPOSE changes — edit a learner’s details, extend access, move batch, activate/deactivate. Every change requires the user to press Confirm on a card before anything is applied. On by default for Admins; other roles are opt-in.

assessments.label: Assessment results
assessments.description: Find assessments and answer questions about submissions, scores, pending evaluations, and leaderboards. On by default for Admins.

announcements.label: Announcements
announcements.description: See planned/past announcements, and PROPOSE sending one to batches, roles, or specific learners — sending always requires pressing Confirm on a card. On by default for Admins.
